items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: Did you know Jack? Sure. I know him. I met him in the Navy, in California. I met Jack Teagarden in California.

ctx.x: What, so, uh, both of the two of you were studying with, uh... Vic Gasper. Vic Gasper at the same time.
At the same time, is. Did you know Jack? Sure. I know him. I met him in the Navy, in California. I met Jack Teagarden in California. You know me?

items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1960-09-16
items.q: Jack Teagarden. Met him in Los Angeles. Yeah. That's funny. He said, hello there. I know you.

ctx.x: Every once in a while, somebody will say that they heard Teagarden here. We know Teagarden. Some people say he played good blues and all. I wonder if he played.

He was a H2, wouldn't he be? Yeah, he was about around my age. Yeah. He was taking lessons same time as you? Same time with me. I never knew that he was. I didn't. Jack Teagarden. From Vic Gasper. But he's playing, he's playing, but he still went to taking lessons. Learned more about it. Learned more about it, you know. I take lessons from Vic Gasper too. He met me in California and know me. I didn't know him, he know me. You remember yours? Jack Teagarden. Met him in Los Angeles. Yeah. That's funny. He said,…
Well, very good. Did you hear him play in those years?
